description: Every design on both workloads at Iceberg's sizes (docs/HYPOTHESES.md, 2026-11-12, W1-W5): the D1-D4 table (205,480,000 rows, 128 MiB row groups in 512 MiB files), one design a job. Updates (150,000 changes a write): MoR, MoR compacted as Iceberg plans its bin-pack (checked after every write, 5 files), RMoR, RMoW-external and RMoR-density with the cut, and RMoW-append over 30 writes (it copies whole row groups). Inserts (350,000 a write): MoR, MoR compacted, and RMoR-density placing them by the event-time merge; RMoR, RMoW-external and RMoW-append, whose event-time merge would write about 2.3 GB a write, are projected, not run (lab/pages/inserts-128.md). 240 writes; range reads after every write, full and sorted reads every 10, under cached-skip. Payload checks off, requests and held memory logged.
